summary: Adds a grafana_router_longrunning_requests{group} gauge, adds a verb label to the request duration histogram, and updates help text. Watches are counted in the new gauge instead of the histogram and in-flight gauge. This changes the exported metric schema, so existing dashboards and alerts on the histogram will see a new label.

issues.title: Unbounded verb label lets clients create new histogram series
issues.failure_scenario: A client sends requests with many distinct HTTP methods (e.g. FOO1, FOO2, ...) to an /apis/ path. The verb falls back to the lowercased method, so each one creates a new native-histogram series, even though the group label is bounded by the unknown-group rule.

headline: Router metrics gain verb label and a watch gauge
reason: Changes exported Prometheus metric names and labels (histogram schema, new gauge, registration), which affect consumers and series cardinality.
focus: dashboards or alerts querying grafana_router_http_request_duration_seconds that may break or aggregate wrongly with the new verb label
